name: RD Technologies HKDR
collateral: 1:1 HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets in segregated custody at licensed financial institutions; reserves to be disclosed via periodic independent attestation per HKMA Stablecoins Ordinance

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: HKDR resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and an HKMA-licensed issuer can freeze and reissue under its compliance program.

launchPhaseDetail: Issued by RD InnoTech Limited (a subsidiary of RD Technologies, founded by former HKMA chief executive Norman Chan); admitted to the HKMA stablecoin issuer sandbox in the first July 2024 cohort; testing digital asset trading and cross-border trade payments, partnership with ZA Bank for regulated use cases; HKMA chief executive Eddie Yue signalled the first wave of fiat-referenced stablecoin licences in March 2026 will be limited to 'a very small number' of issuers and RD InnoTech is widely cited as a leading candidate; HK$25M minimum paid-up capital and 100%+ reserve backing requirements already met under sandbox conditions

featuredContent.title: Announcement: RD Technologies joins the HKMA Stablecoin Issuer Sandbox
featuredContent.description: RD InnoTech enters the first July 2024 HKMA sandbox cohort to test HKDR for digital asset trading and cross-border trade payments.

featuredContent.title: RD Technologies celebrates passage of Stablecoins Ordinance in Hong Kong
featuredContent.description: RD Technologies welcomes Hong Kong's stablecoin regulatory framework; positions HKDR for licensing under the new regime taking effect August 2025.

featuredContent.title: Hong Kong signals caution in stablecoin license rollout
featuredContent.description: HKMA chief executive Eddie Yue signals only a 'very small number' of stablecoin licences will be granted in the first wave, targeting March 2026 issuance.

milestones.title: RD InnoTech enters HKMA Stablecoin Issuer Sandbox (first cohort)
milestones.description: HKDR begins sandbox testing for digital asset trading and cross-border trade payments under HKMA supervision.

milestones.title: Hong Kong Stablecoins Ordinance passed; takes effect August 1 2025
milestones.description: Legislative Council passes the Stablecoins Ordinance, mandating HKMA licensing for issuers of fiat-referenced stablecoins; RD Technologies welcomes the framework.

milestones.title: HKMA confirms first batch of stablecoin licences targeted for March 2026
milestones.description: Eddie Yue signals stability over speed and limits initial licences to 'a very small number'; RD InnoTech named among credible candidates given early sandbox participation.
